name: Tranard Roberts
strengths: Roberts presses the hole, plants on one cut, and is already vertical into the second level without dancing.
Roberts finishes runs with real contact balance at 5-11.5 / 195 — stiff-arms, churns through arm tackles, and falls forward.
Roberts shows mature vision: he presses the line to freeze linebackers, then hits the designed seam or the cutback.
Roberts has a clear second gear once he clears the second level and can finish outside when the edge is there.
weaknesses: Roberts wins more north-south than with phone-booth wiggle — pass-game / every-down protection proof still needs to stack on junior tape.
comparison: Roberts comps to Quinshon Judkins — 5-11 / ~210 mold; patient one-cut vision, contact balance, and downhill finish (size-matched to Roberts' 5-11.5 / 195 frame before fill-out).
projection: Roberts projects as develop into the Florida RB room, earn early package and special-teams snaps, then compete for a feature/RB1 role — starter upside as a vision-first one-cut back.
schemeFit: Roberts fits a zone/gap RB room that wants one-cut decisiveness, between-tackle finish, and enough juice to stress the edge.
insiderNotes: Roberts is a sturdy 5-11.5 / 195 Villages Charter back who presses the hole on one cut, finishes through contact, and shows a clear second gear outside. Wins with vision and contact balance — a Judkins-mold feature back Florida is still chasing in the Closing Class.
staffNotes: Vault film desk verified 2026-08-13 from IMG sophomore Hudl embed (Sophomore Szn). Comp size-matched within ~1–2" — not a Florida-alum default. Not provisional.
